_comment: Per-stage multiplier on top of each scan's estimated metresPerUnit (README says the estimate can be off by 20-30%). Raise it if the character looks too big for the scan, then rerun make_scan_collision.py and build_scan_stages.py.
_Hongdae: street measured 3-6 m wide at x1.0 but it is a two-lane road with sidewalks
_Gyeonggijeon: the README's reference scan, matched against real measurements
_Gwanghwamun: the railed platform measured 18 x 31 m at x1.0; the real Woldae is 29.7 x 48.7 m
_JejuPier: no reference measured; uses the same correction as Gwanghwamun, whose scale was estimated the same way
